limitations: Product identity is a separate runtime field and denotes the selected digital twin, not an identity inferred from source copy.
Tassel uses reviewed PDF views; Messi uses its ZIP views. These are distinct products.
Regular preset renders are 16:9; CAM_review includes alternate image dimensions. Never apply a new crop or aspect ratio based on these profiles.
Offline object limits remain unvalidated image-quality hypotheses.

product_overrides.reason: Unlike Magic/Tassel, supplied regular Messi close views show a small product with broad surrounding margins. Allow one extra modest cue, but do not fill all blank space, enlarge the product, or add prominent people. These are offline qualitative limits, not occupancy-derived capacity.
Very tight tall framing in the reviewed Viktor view; favor only the support surface and light.

unknown_product_policy: Use the registered camera base conservatively without product overrides; mark product resolution unknown. Do not guess equivalence from customer-facing brand or product names.
incompatible_type_policy: Minimal surface-and-light prompt; no props, people or named room fixtures; mark incompatible.
